subject: Prioritization matrix for deferred offers and band realignment
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Recruiting Ops <recruiting@talentops.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q4 bandwidth + offer queue — quick ask

Team,

We need to lock down guidance by EOD Monday on which offers we push, which we hold, and any temporary band exceptions we’re willing to approve for critical roles. Finance will need a consolidated ask for the reserved-capacity budget reallocation. High level:

- Hiring freeze remains org-wide, but we want to allow limited exceptions (up to 6 roles) for revenue-impacting positions.
- Recruiting has a deferred-offer queue of 14 candidates; several are senior ICs with requests above current band midpoints.
- We should produce a 1-page priority matrix (impact x urgency) plus a short comp-exception playbook for approvals.

Renee and Samir from TalentOps are on this thread to confirm timelines for offer holds and candidate communication. Can each of you confirm: 1) up to how many exceptions you’d be willing to sign off on today, and 2) one concrete criterion we should use to rank candidates? I’ll consolidate and share a matrix with Finance/Legal.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 12:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 bandwidth + offer queue — quick ask

Vivek —

I can approve up to 2 exceptions that are clearly tied to closed deals or pilots scheduled to kick off before Feb. Criteria I recommend:

1) Revenue-tied (deal or pilot where candidate is on critical path)
2) Time-to-value (hiring reduces go-live by >6 weeks)
3) Unique skill set not available internally (no reasonable backfill)

Practical note for Recruiting: prioritize candidates with start dates < 60 days and where counteroffers are likely. I updated the matrix (attached) with my top 5.

-Lauren
Director, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Q4_priority_matrix_v2.xlsx (sheet: GTM-priorities)

From: Renee Park <reneep@talentops.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 09:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 bandwidth + offer queue — quick ask

Marissa / team,

Recruiting Ops here — quick operational status:

- Deferred-offer queue: 14 candidates 
  - 6 candidates flagged as "high risk" (active counteroffers)
  - 4 candidates are senior ICs asking above band midpoint; 2 are asking ~10% above midpoint.
- We can hold offers with candidate-friendly language for up to 30 days. Beyond that we need to reconfirm compensation.

Attached is a short comp-band-summary we pulled together to show current band midpoints, typical uplift ranges, and suggested approvers per level. If Finance needs a single ask, the simplest path is to request a temporary band uplift fund (one-time pool) that covers up to 8% uplift for up to 4 hires. That avoids permanent band changes but gives us flexibility.

We’ll need final direction by Monday EOD to communicate with candidates without creating churn. If you want, Samir and I can run a 20-minute sync Monday morning to go over the matrix and draft the candidate-facing hold language.

Thanks,
Renee
Recruiting Ops Lead, TalentOps
Attachments: comp-band-summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Renee Park <reneep@talentops.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Samir Naik <samir.naik@talentops.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 18:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 bandwidth + offer queue — quick ask

Folks — thanks for the fast turnaround. Summary & next steps: 

1) Exceptions cap: Approve up to 4 total exceptions today. Allocation: 2 for GTM (Lauren) + 1 for Product (Aditya) + 1 for Ops/Infra (Vivek) — exceptions are single-hire approvals and should be treated as one-off, not band precedent.

2) Temporary uplift fund: agree to request a one-time uplift pool (up to 8% uplift, covers up to 4 hires) from Finance. I’ll draft the ask and include the priority matrix + candidate list.

3) Candidate comms: Recruiting Ops to issue candidate-friendly hold language (max 30 days). If counteroffers surface, Recruiting Ops to escalate immediately to the approver linked to the role.

4) Band realignment: We will not change permanent comp bands now. Any role that requires >8% uplift will be closed or re-queued for next quarter unless it meets "revenue-tied" criteria and gets CEO sign-off.

Action items:
- Marissa: submit uplift request to Finance (Mon morning) + attach matrix.
- Lauren/Aditya/Vivek: finalize top candidates for your allocations (send to Recruiting by Mon 10:00 PT).
- Renee/Samir: prepare candidate hold language + confirm which offers are truly high risk.

I’ll set a 20-minute sync for Mon 10:30 PT to finalize. Thanks team — keep messages short in candidate threads.

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Talent Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: Q4_priority_matrix_v2.xlsx, comp-band-summary.pdf
